title: Industrial Nexus: Integrations
summary: Feed factories with stable power, item routes, scans, records, and clear diagnostics.

blocks.title: Connected Systems
blocks.body: PowerGrid supplies stable energy, Logistics moves inputs and outputs, Index explains recipes, and MultiblockCore can host larger facility goals.

blocks.title: Practical Pairings
blocks.body: Use PowerGrid for stable energy, Logistics for inputs and outputs, MultiblockCore for larger structures, and Index for recipe or machine references.

blocks.title: Fallback Play
blocks.body: Without automation helpers, run the line in smaller batches, label every input and output, and check heat or power before walking away.

blocks.title: Fallback Check
blocks.body: If the helper addon is absent, keep the same order by hand and follow the manual checkpoint.
